section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因用PCR基因扩增仪，包括PCR基因扩增仪本体，且PCR基因扩增仪本体底部外壁四角均固定连接有支撑腿，且支撑腿底部外径大于顶部外径，所述PCR基因扩增仪本体顶部外壁一端开有放样槽，且放样槽底部内壁设置有放样板，所述放样板顶部外壁开有多个试管槽，所述放样槽两侧内壁均通过阻尼转动连接有槽盖，且槽盖底部内壁固定连接有转动电机，且转动电机顶部外部转动连接有螺纹丝杠。本实用新型能够对长时间暴露在空气中的放样板和试管槽进行往复性紫外线照射，避免空气中的影响PCR基因扩增仪检测结果的物质进入到设备内部造成检测结果不准确，并且能够对过滤网板进行便携式拆卸与安装。

The utility model discloses a PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene, including PCR gene amplification appearance body, and the equal fixedly connected with supporting leg in PCR gene amplification appearance body bottom outer wall four corners, and supporting leg bottom external diameter is greater than the top external diameter, PCR gene amplification appearance body top outer wall one end is opened has the lofting groove, and lofting groove bottom inner wall is provided with the lofting board, lofting board top outer wall is opened has a plurality of test-tube slots, lofting groove both sides inner wall all rotates through the damping and is connected with the capping, and capping bottom inner wall fixedly connected with rotates the motor, and rotates the outside rotation in motor top and be connected with the screw thread lead screw. The utility model discloses can carry out reciprocal ultraviolet irradiation to the model of putting in the air for a long time and test-tube slot, avoid the material of the influence PCR gene amplification appearance testing result in the air to enter into the inside testing result that causes of equipment inaccurate to can carry out portable dismantlement and installation to filtering the otter board.

PCR gene amplification instrument for biological geneTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a PCR gene amplification appearance technical field especially relates to a PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene.

Background

The PCR amplification apparatus, also known as PCR gene amplification apparatus, PCR nucleic acid amplification apparatus, is an apparatus for amplifying specific DNA by using PCR technology, and is widely used in medical and biological laboratories, for example, to determine whether a sample will show a map of a certain genetic disease, diagnose infectious diseases, copy genes, and identify parents.

However, when the existing PCR gene amplification apparatus detects the solution in the test tube, it needs continuous experiments, and thus the cover of the slot needs to be opened many times to pick and place the test tube, which may cause the sample-placing plate and the test tube slot to be exposed in the air for a long time, and the air may contain various substances that affect the detection result, such as small segment of nucleic acid, etc., which may cause the detection result to be false positive.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to solve the defects in the prior art and provides a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes comprises a PCR gene amplification instrument body, wherein four corners of the bottom outer wall of the PCR gene amplification instrument body are fixedly connected with supporting legs, the outer diameter of the bottom of each supporting leg is larger than the outer diameter of the top of each supporting leg, one end of the top outer wall of the PCR gene amplification instrument body is provided with a lofting groove, the inner wall of the bottom of the lofting groove is provided with a lofting plate, the outer wall of the top of the lofting plate is provided with a plurality of test tube grooves, the inner walls of two sides of the lofting groove are rotatably connected with a groove cover through damping, the inner wall of the bottom of the groove cover is fixedly connected with a rotating motor, the outer part of the top of the rotating motor is rotatably connected with a threaded lead screw, the outer part of the threaded lead screw is provided with a fixed block, the outer walls of two sides of the fixed block are fixedly connected with a limiting rod, the inner walls of two sides of the groove cover are respectively provided with a limiting groove, the limiting grooves are matched with the limiting rod, the outer wall of one end of the fixed block is fixedly connected with a transverse plate, and one end of the transverse plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of ultraviolet lamps, the plurality of ultraviolet lamps are uniformly distributed on the transverse plate, and the outer wall of the top of the groove cover is fixedly connected with a handle rod.

Furthermore, a control panel is arranged on the inclined plane of the outer wall of the top of the PCR gene amplification instrument body.

Furthermore, the outer walls of the two sides of the PCR gene amplification instrument body are provided with handle grooves at positions close to the top.

Furthermore, a plurality of air holes are formed in the outer walls of the two sides of the PCR gene amplification instrument body and close to the bottom, the air holes are convex, and the air holes are arranged in a matrix.

Furthermore, a fixing plate is arranged inside the air holes, and fixing bolts are fixedly connected between the fixing plate and the inner wall of the air holes.

Furthermore, one end of each fixing plate close to the inside of the PCR gene amplification instrument body is fixedly connected with a filter screen plate, and the size of each filter screen plate is matched with the inner wall of each vent hole.

The utility model has the advantages that:

1. through the capping that sets up, the rotation motor, the screw thread lead screw, the gag lever post, the spacing groove, diaphragm and ultraviolet lamp, when model and test-tube groove expose for a long time in the air, close the capping, the rotation motor is just reversing to drive the screw thread lead screw and is rotated, under the restriction of spacing groove and gag lever post, the fixed block can be reciprocating motion along the screw thread lead screw, herein simultaneously, open ultraviolet lamp, make a round trip to reciprocate to test-tube groove and model and carry out ultraviolet irradiation, eliminate the material that probably influences the testing result, be convenient for PCR gene amplification appearance body next time during operation obtains more accurate testing result, improve the accuracy of PCR gene amplification appearance.

2. Through the bleeder vent that sets up, the fixed plate, fixing bolt and filter plate, PCR gene amplification appearance body during operation inside production of heat is higher, in order to avoid ambient temperature to exert an influence to detecting, the heat is discharged through the bleeder vent of matrix arrangement, in the heat dissipation process, it can avoid impurity in the ambient air and the material that probably influences PCR gene amplification appearance body testing result to filter the plate and permeate through the bleeder vent and enter into PCR gene amplification appearance body inside, after filter plate work a period, can carry out portable dismantlement to it through fixed plate and fixing bolt.

3. Through the handle groove that sets up, can be convenient for transport PCR gene amplification appearance body, improve the suitability of this device.

Detailed Description

The technical solution of the present patent will be described in further detail with reference to the following embodiments.

Reference will now be made in detail to embodiments of the present patent, examples of which are illustrated in the accompanying drawings, wherein like or similar reference numerals refer to the same or similar elements or elements having the same or similar function throughout. The embodiments described below with reference to the drawings are exemplary only for the purpose of explaining the present patent and are not to be construed as limiting the present patent.

In the description of this patent, it is to be understood that the terms "center," "upper," "lower," "front," "rear," "left," "right," "vertical," "horizontal," "top," "bottom," "inner," "outer," and the like are used in the orientations and positional relationships indicated in the drawings for the convenience of describing the patent and for the simplicity of description, and are not intended to indicate or imply that the referenced devices or elements must have a particular orientation, be constructed and operated in a particular orientation, and are not to be considered limiting of the patent.

In the description of this patent, it is noted that unless otherwise specifically stated or limited, the terms "mounted," "connected," and "disposed" are to be construed broadly and can include, for example, fixedly connected, disposed, detachably connected, disposed, or integrally connected and disposed. The specific meaning of the above terms in this patent may be understood by those of ordinary skill in the art as appropriate.

Referring to FIGS. 1 to 3, a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes, comprising a PCR gene amplification instrument body 2, wherein four corners of the outer wall of the bottom of the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 are all connected with supporting legs 1 through bolts, the outer diameter of the bottom of the supporting legs 1 is larger than that of the top, one end of the outer wall of the top of the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 is provided with a lofting groove 3, the inner wall of the bottom of the lofting groove 3 is provided with a lofting plate 8, the outer wall of the top of the lofting plate 8 is provided with a plurality of test tube grooves 4, the inner walls of two sides of the lofting groove 3 are both rotatably connected with a groove cover 5 through damping, the inner wall of the bottom of the groove cover 5 is connected with a rotating motor 10 through bolts, the outer part of the top of the rotating motor 10 is rotatably connected with a threaded lead screw 15, the outer part of the threaded lead screw 15 is provided with a fixed block, the outer walls of two sides of the fixed block are both connected with a limiting rod 13 through bolts, the inner walls of two sides of the groove cover 5 are both provided with limiting grooves 11, and the limiting grooves 11 are matched with the limiting rod 13, fixed block one end outer wall has diaphragm 12 through bolted connection, and diaphragm 12 one end outer wall has a plurality of ultraviolet lamps 16 through bolted connection, and a plurality of ultraviolet lamps 16 evenly distributed are on diaphragm 12, and 5 top outer walls of capping have handle bar 14 through bolted connection.

Wherein, the inclined plane of the outer wall of the top of the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 is provided with a control panel 7.

Wherein, the outer walls of the two sides of the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 are provided with handle grooves 6 near the top.

Wherein, the position that 2 both sides outer walls of PCR gene amplification appearance body are close to the bottom has all opened a plurality of bleeder vents 9, and bleeder vent 9 is protruding type, and a plurality of bleeder vents 9 are the matrix arrangement, can be convenient for discharge the heat that PCR gene amplification appearance during operation produced.

Wherein, a fixing plate 17 is arranged inside the plurality of air holes 9, and a fixing bolt 18 is connected between the fixing plate 17 and the inner wall of the air hole 9 through a bolt, so that the filter screen plate 19 can be conveniently detached and installed.

Wherein, the one end that a plurality of fixed plates 17 are close to PCR gene amplification appearance 2 inside all has filter screen plate 19 through bolted connection, and filter screen plate 19 size and bleeder vent 9 inner wall and suit, can avoid influencing the material of PCR gene amplification appearance testing result in the outside air, improves the accuracy that this device detected.

The working principle is as follows: when the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 works, the heat generated inside the PCR gene amplification instrument body is high, in order to avoid the influence of the external temperature on the detection, the heat is discharged through the air holes 9 arranged in the matrix, in the heat radiation process, the filter screen plate 19 can prevent impurities in the external air and substances which may influence the detection result of the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 from entering the PCR gene amplification instrument body 2 through the air holes 9, after the filter screen plate 19 works for a period of time, the filter screen plate can be conveniently disassembled through the fixing plate 17 and the fixing bolt 18, when the sample placing plate 8 and the test tube groove 4 are exposed in the air for a long time, the groove cover 5 is closed, the rotating motor 10 rotates forward and backward to drive the threaded lead screw 15 to rotate, under the limitation of the limiting groove 11 and the limiting rod 13, the fixing block can do reciprocating motion along the threaded lead screw 15, meanwhile, the ultraviolet lamp 16 is opened, carry out ultraviolet irradiation to test tube groove 4 and lofting board 8 reciprocal, eliminate the material that probably influences the testing result, the PCR gene amplification appearance body 2 of being convenient for obtains more accurate testing result in next during operation, improves the detection accuracy of PCR gene amplification appearance.

The utility model discloses a control mode comes automatic control through the controller, and the control circuit of controller can realize through the simple programming of technical staff in this field, and the supply also belongs to the common general knowledge in this field, and the utility model discloses mainly used protects mechanical device, so the utility model discloses no longer explain control mode and circuit connection in detail.
